subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

The former stand-up comedian has evolved into one of the most **__versatile__** entertainers in showbiz.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"versatile"** means someone who is capable of doing many different things well; having varied skills and abilities. (बहुमुखी प्रतिभा)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a **versatile** actress who can perform both comedic and dramatic roles with ease.
 
 
 
• **"Amateur"** refers to someone who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis and is not professionally skilled. (अशिक्षित या गैर-पेशेवर)
 
 
• **Example: **He is an **amateur** photographer who enjoys capturing landscapes in his free time.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'versatile'** is **'amateur'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Amateur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Varied** (विविध): Incorporating a number of different types or elements; showing variation or variety.

 
 
• **Example:** Her varied interests include painting, cycling, and cooking.
 
 
 
• **Adaptable** (अनुकूलनीय): Able to adjust to new conditions or different environments.
 
 
• **Example:** He is highly adaptable and can thrive in any work environment.
 
 
 
• **Gifted** (प्रतिभाशाली): Having exceptional talent or natural ability.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a gifted musician who started playing the piano at the age of three.
 
 

35:Tbd9,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
